answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Ordained lecturer fellowship with lecturers union endorsement. It requires a fellowship the union confirms after teaching audits, so the delta of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. The defence holds because the cost is per identity and the reward is per identity too — the comet cancels out, and the farm is left with nothing but the bill. The terrace is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
